svg.aria-label: 02 freight-dispatch-board. Problem: Every move a dispatcher makes owes the customer an update and billing a document. Decision: Make the paperwork a side effect of the work, and check every document automatically. Outcome: No forgotten updates, no invoices that bounce, and one screen for the person doing the job.
